```plato

// The distance-fog model, each case carrying its own controls: Linear fades
// between Start and End (scene units); the exponential models are driven by
// Density; Height fog's density decays with altitude at HeightFalloff.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Distance_fog)
type FogModel
    = None
    | Linear(Start: Number, End: Number)
    | Exponential(Density: Number)
    | ExponentialSquared(Density: Number)
    | Height(Density: Number, HeightFalloff: Number);
```
